tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
TP-Link Archer C6 V3.20 Dual-Band Gigabit Wireless Router | Wi-Fi 5 | MU-MIMO | Mesh Support


Upgrade your home or office network with the TP-Link Archer C6 V3.20—a powerful and reliable Wi-Fi 5 router designed for high-speed performance and wide coverage. Ideal for streaming, gaming, and managing smart devices, this dual-band router delivers seamless wireless connectivity and supports over 50 concurrent users.

Key Features:

  • Model: TP-Link Archer C6 V3.20
  • Router Type: Wireless & Ethernet
  • Wi-Fi Standard: 802.11ac (Wi-Fi 5)
  • Dual Band: 2.4GHz & 5GHz for faster and more stable connections
  • Antenna: 4 × Fixed High-Gain Antennas
  • MIMO Technology: Yes (MU-MIMO for optimized performance across multiple devices)
  • Mesh Support: Compatible with OneMesh™ for seamless whole-home coverage
  • Wi-Fi Coverage: Up to 2000 sq. ft., perfect for medium to large homes
  • LAN/WAN Ports: Gigabit 10/100/1000 Mbps for ultra-fast wired connections
  • Concurrent Users: Supports 51+ users, ideal for busy households or small businesses
  • Color: Sleek Black Finish


Why Choose TP-Link Archer C6?

  • Smooth 4K streaming and online gaming with high-speed dual-band Wi-Fi
  • Advanced security and parental controls via the TP-Link Tether app
  • Easy setup and remote management from your smartphone
  • Cost-effective, high-performance router trusted by millions globally
